Messages.Author: Roger Carhult
Messages.Body:
On the namesday of Set, the 30th of December, 20 Methuselahs gathered to
determine who would be given the right to bear the glory of the Dark God
into the year 2002. Here's the players and their decks and VPs on the 3
preliminary rounds:

Henrik 'Oskis' Oscarsson - Setite corruption deck - 1,5VP
Fredrik Axelzon - Lasombra Embrace deck with Power Structure and lots of
Consangenous Boons. This deck won a special prize (Dismemberment of Osiris)
for the coolest deck. - 1VP
Daniel Bakken - Omaya intercept-it-all-deck with Smiling Jacks. - 3,5 VP
Johan 'Bern' Carlsson - !Malkavian Derange and Lunatic Eruption deck. - 0VP
Sten Düring - Ventrue deck with some Kiss of Ra - 2VP
Haviet Kok - Ravnos deck with mostly weenies, embraces and Week of
Nightmares. - 4VP
Sven-Inge Möller - Weenie dominate (I think) - 1VP
Patrik 'Pata' Lesnik - Anneke-intercept and equipment with Black Cat and
Pier 13. - 1,5VP
Archibald 'Archie' Zimonyi - Some strange mix of Anton, Rebekka, Muaziz and
stuff. Based on perma-intercept and stealth on the minions. - 0,5VP
Elias 'Ille' Rolén - !Toreador vote deck with obfuscate and Protected
Resources. - 4VP
Roger Carhult (me) - Ulugh Beg with malks. Lots of 2nd Traditions and
Obedience with Ulugh and some S&B with malks. - 0VP
Henrik 'Henke' Isaksson - Malkavians with equipment and Hidden Lurkers.
Beatrice Düring - Ani (and auspex too I think) intercept deck with Gangrels
and Raven Spies. - 5,5 VP
Daniel Ahlberg - Traditional mono-S&B - 8,5VP
Hans Nemeczek - Same as above... - 10VP
Keiko Düring - Brujah fight deck - 0,5 VP
Magnus Andersson - Gangrel fight deck - 0VP
Simon Carlsson - Dragos protean deck with Mythic Forms - 1VP
Andreas Gustavsson - Tzimisce deck (never saw it play) - 1,5VP
Johan Hansson - !Toreador vote deck with tons of KRC and no intercept at
all. - 11VP

Some highlights:

Oskis put Temptations on all of my 4 minion in the same turn.
Bern played Lunatic Eruption on Omaya (and all of Bakken's other minions),
who then got an Obf skill card and Disguised out a Flamethrower and sent
poor Sten's minion to torpor who had Fame.
Bern put Lunatic Eruptions on all of my minions crippling my no-combat deck
totally :/
Bern hunted Archie and Deranged all his vamps (Muaziz, Anton and Rebekka)
into !Malks. Then Archie has an Institution HG in his hand!!
Henke managed did a couple of Amaranths throughout the tourney.
Henke tried to block my Gilbert from rescueing Ulugh in torpor. He throws up
+5 intercept and Gilbert managed to stealth through with +6 stealth (without
Forgotten Labyrinth).
Fredrik won the C-final and finished it with 8 minion and 65 pool (without
stalling the game to get it)!

The final:

Johan Hansson (!Tor) ---> Hans Nemeczek (Malk) ---> Ille (!Tor) --->
Beatrice (gangrel intercept) ---> Daniel (Malk)

An early deal was made where table was split and Johan Hansson who had lots
of votes feared that Daniel would oust him quickly and made a deal with
Hans. He'd help him to win and then Hans would be ousted by Johan. Ille was
soon bled out. Beatrice managed to resist the Malks for a while, but was
eventually bled out by Hans. Daniel put pressure on Johan with his bleeds
and Johan was nearly ousted when Hans managed to oust Daniel too. Then Johan
bled out Hans who kept his deal.

The final was pretty boring in that a quite early deal was made and with
boring Malk S&B decks it was over quite wuickly. Kudos to Beatrice who at
least played an intercept deck that got quite many VPs into the final and
there made things a bit more interesting for a while.

And the winning deck was:
